name: The Fallen of Angel
source: Aki’s Summer with Family is a choice-driven visual novel where you play as Aki, an innocent young man who moves in with his aunt and cousins for the summer. What starts as a wholesome family reunion quickly reveals hidden desires lurking beneath the surface…
translation: 《阿秋与家人的夏日时光》是一款由选择驱动的视觉小说。你将扮演纯真青年阿秋，在暑假期间搬去与姨母和表姐妹们同住。一场起初温馨和睦的家庭团聚，很快便揭开了潜藏在平静表象之下的隐秘欲望……
